purpose: Freeze the admissible fixed-composition conservative/primitive conversion layer required before production variable-thermochemistry solver integration.

conservative_to_primitive: T = bounded inverse of e(T,Y) over the common source-valid species interval

scientific_boundaries: Composition is fixed for one supplied state array in this stage; cell-wise composition evolution belongs to the later teacher mixing/reaction closure.
Absolute chemical-energy enthalpy is retained; rhoE is not required to be positive solely because the chosen thermochemical datum can be negative.
No temperature clipping or polynomial extrapolation is allowed.
The constant-gamma production state path remains accepted and unchanged until variable-state integration is independently promoted.
next_step: Add a deliberately separate variable-thermo Euler flux/RHS compatibility path using fixed composition, verify conservation and constant-property limiting behavior, then integrate with source terms only after that gate passes.
